**Finding: deviation (Section 12.4, ¶p0045)**

Section 12.4 imposes a one-way, 24-month **no-hire** on us covering *any* Vendor employee, and expressly defeats any general-advertising/unsolicited-application carve-out ("regardless of how the employee applies"). This fails the fallback on every material term (mutuality, involved-personnel scope, 12 months, carve-outs, no no-hire) and falls into walk-away territory. It also directly contradicts Section 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we have made no no-hire commitment and remain free to hire anyone responding to general recruitment.

Redline validated (ok:true): delete Section 12.4, with the narrow mutual 12-month non-solicit offered as a fallback in the comment.
